title: Stop time and tap dancers; cutting notes
summary: Miller explains that stop time was made for tap dancers, that he played Sweet Suit behind them, and that cut notes do not fit a hot solo.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets
